blocks.zh: 導論與關鍵概念
blocks.en: Introduction and Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 C&Q（Commissioning and Qualification，試車與確效）的核心定義，以及它與傳統 IQ/OQ/PQ 方法的本質差異
blocks.en: Understand the core definition of C&Q (Commissioning and Qualification) and how it fundamentally differs from the traditional IQ/OQ/PQ approach

blocks.zh: 掌握 CDE（Critical Design Element，關鍵設計要素）、CA（Critical Aspect，關鍵特性）與 CPP/CQA 之間的層級關係
blocks.en: Grasp the hierarchy among CDE (Critical Design Element), CA (Critical Aspect), and CPP/CQA

blocks.zh: 了解本指引第二版的主要改版邏輯——為何廢除 V-Model、重視 QRM，以及何謂「不重複測試」原則
blocks.en: Understand the logic behind the major changes in the second edition of this Guide: why the V-Model was dropped, the emphasis on QRM, and what the "no repeat testing" principle means

blocks.zh: 熟悉本章定義的 15 個關鍵術語，並能區分 Commissioning、Qualification、Verification 三者的異同
blocks.en: Become familiar with the 15 key terms defined in this chapter, and be able to distinguish Commissioning, Qualification, and Verification

blocks.zh: 理解 Quality Unit（品質單位）在 C&Q 過程中的正確角色定位
blocks.en: Understand the correct role of the Quality Unit in the C&Q process

blocks.zh: 1.1 Background（背景）
blocks.en: 1.1 Background

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：C&Q 的本質
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Essence of C&Q

blocks.zh: Commissioning（試車）：工程師確認系統按設計安裝並正常運作的過程。強調技術符合性，不需要 QA 審批。
blocks.en: Commissioning: the process by which engineers confirm that a system is installed as designed and operates properly. It emphasizes technical conformity and does not require QA approval.

blocks.zh: Qualification（確效）：在 Commissioning 基礎上，由 Quality Unit 監督，聚焦於產品品質風險，證明系統「適合預定用途」。
blocks.en: Qualification: building on Commissioning, and under Quality Unit oversight, focuses on product quality risk to demonstrate that the system is "fit for intended use".

blocks.zh: 兩者的關鍵差異只有一個：Quality Unit 的參與程度。這個洞見是本版 ISPE 指引最重要的訊息之一。
blocks.en: The key difference between the two is just one thing: the degree of Quality Unit involvement. This insight is one of the most important messages of this edition of the ISPE Guide.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：工廠安裝如同蓋新廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: Installing a Plant Is Like Building a New Kitchen

blocks.zh:
想像你開一家餐廳，安裝全新廚房設備。
Commissioning = 水電師傅確認瓦斯爐點火正常、冰箱溫度正確——這是工程驗收。
Qualification = 衛生局稽查員確認設備符合食安標準，並核發許可——這是法規合規層面。
藥廠的 C&Q 就是把「工程驗收」和「法規合規」整合成一個有效率的流程，避免重複測試。
blocks.en:
Imagine you open a restaurant and install brand-new kitchen equipment.
Commissioning = the technician confirms that the gas stove ignites properly and the refrigerator holds the right temperature. This is engineering acceptance.
Qualification = the health department inspector confirms that the equipment meets food safety standards and issues a permit. This is the regulatory compliance layer.
C&Q in a pharmaceutical plant integrates "engineering acceptance" and "regulatory compliance" into one efficient process that avoids repeat testing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：名稱不重要，方法才重要
blocks.en: Key Point: The Method Matters More Than the Names

blocks.zh: ISPE 刻意說「術語不如方法重要」，是因為各公司、各國法規對 IQ/OQ/PQ/FAT/SAT 的叫法差異極大。ISPE Vol.5 2nd Ed. 提供的是一套方法論框架，讓你不管用什麼名詞，都能做到符合法規的確效。
blocks.en: ISPE deliberately says that terminology matters less than method, because companies and national regulations use very different names for IQ/OQ/PQ/FAT/SAT. ISPE Vol. 5 2nd Ed. provides a methodological framework that lets you achieve compliant qualification regardless of the terms you use.

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500 將整個過程稱為「verification」，與 ICH Q10 用語不同——這種差異在稽查時常造成混淆，本指引明確統一使用 C&Q 框架。
blocks.en: ASTM E2500 calls the entire process "verification", which differs from the wording of ICH Q10. This difference often causes confusion during inspections, and this Guide explicitly standardizes on the C&Q framework.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一台新安裝的 WFI 系統，工程師完成了管路焊接檢查與水質確認，但尚未通知 QA 審核，這個活動屬於 Commissioning 還是 Qualification？為什麼？
blocks.en: For a newly installed WFI system, engineers have completed the piping weld inspection and water quality confirmation but have not yet notified QA for review. Is this activity Commissioning or Qualification? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果一個系統不影響產品品質（例如廠務用自來水管），它是否需要進行 Qualification？請根據本節的定義解釋你的答案。
blocks.en: If a system does not affect product quality (for example, utility mains water piping), does it require Qualification? Explain your answer based on the definitions in this section.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Purpose and Objectives（目的與目標）
blocks.en: 1.2 Purpose and Objectives

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CQA → CPP → CA → CDE 層級關係
blocks.en: Core Concept: The CQA → CPP → CA → CDE Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 這是 ISPE Vol.5 整個框架的邏輯主軸，必須完全理解：
blocks.en: This is the logical backbone of the entire ISPE Vol. 5 framework and must be fully understood:

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）：藥品必須符合的品質特性，如無菌性、含量、pH
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute): a quality characteristic the drug product must meet, such as sterility, assay, or pH

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）：影響 CQA 的製程參數，如滅菌溫度、充填重量
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter): a process parameter that affects a CQA, such as sterilization temperature or fill weight

blocks.zh: CA（關鍵特性）：製程中必須確保的功能或能力（來自 ASTM E2500）
blocks.en: CA (Critical Aspect): a function or capability that must be ensured in the process (from ASTM E2500)

blocks.zh: CDE（關鍵設計要素）：設備/系統中直接影響 CA 的具體設計功能或物理特徵
blocks.en: CDE (Critical Design Element): a specific design function or physical feature of the equipment/system that directly affects a CA

blocks.zh: 確效的核心任務就是：驗證所有 CDE 都已按設計安裝並正常運作。
blocks.en: The core task of qualification is to verify that all CDEs are installed as designed and operate properly.

blocks.zh: 關係鏈示意圖
blocks.en: Relationship Chain Diagram

blocks.zh:
CQA（藥品品質要求）
  ↓ 由 QRM 識別
CPP（製程關鍵參數）
  ↓ 由 SME 分析
CA（系統關鍵特性）
  ↓ 由設計工程師轉化
CDE（設備關鍵設計要素）
  ↓ 由 C&Q 計畫驗證
System Qualification（系統確效）
blocks.en:
CQA (drug product quality requirements)
  ↓ identified through QRM
CPP (critical process parameters)
  ↓ analyzed by SMEs
CA (critical aspects of the system)
  ↓ translated by design engineers
CDE (critical design elements of the equipment)
  ↓ verified by the C&Q plan
System Qualification

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：聚焦 CDE 就像電動車安全稽核
blocks.en: Analogy: Focusing on CDEs Is Like an Electric Vehicle Safety Audit

blocks.zh: 稽核一台電動車的安全性，你不需要測試每一顆螺絲。你只需要確認那些真正影響行車安全的關鍵元件（剎車系統、電池過熱保護、方向盤轉向機構）都按規格安裝並正常運作。
blocks.en: To audit the safety of an electric vehicle, you do not need to test every screw. You only need to confirm that the components that truly affect driving safety (the braking system, battery overheating protection, the steering mechanism) are installed to specification and operate properly.

blocks.zh: CDE 就是這些「關鍵元件」的藥廠版本——只測試真正重要的，不做無意義的重複測試。
blocks.en: CDEs are the pharmaceutical plant version of these "critical components": test only what really matters and avoid pointless repeat testing.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 C&Q 效益
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Benefits of C&Q for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，採用 ISPE C&Q 框架的直接商業效益：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the direct business benefits of adopting the ISPE C&Q framework are:

blocks.zh: 縮短驗證時間：FAT 廠驗數據可直接作為 IQ 證據，不需到廠重做
blocks.en: Shorter qualification time: FAT data can be used directly as IQ evidence, with no need to repeat the work on site

blocks.zh: 降低成本：只聚焦 CDE，避免對非關鍵元件的過度測試
blocks.en: Lower cost: focusing only on CDEs avoids excessive testing of non-critical components

blocks.zh: 加速新客戶引進：標準化的 URS → DQ → C&Q 流程，讓客戶稽查更順暢
blocks.en: Faster onboarding of new clients: a standardized URS → DQ → C&Q process makes client audits smoother

blocks.zh: 強化法規辯護性：System Risk Assessment 文件是 FDA 483 最佳防禦工具
blocks.en: Stronger regulatory defensibility: System Risk Assessment documentation is the best defense against an FDA 483

blocks.zh: 一台新型凍乾機的「擱板溫度均勻性」屬於 CA 還是 CDE？請說明你的分析邏輯。
blocks.en: Is "shelf temperature uniformity" of a new freeze dryer a CA or a CDE? Explain your analysis logic.

blocks.zh: GEP（Good Engineering Practice）與 GMP 文件要求有何本質差異？ISPE 為何要特別強調 GEP 標準？
blocks.en: What is the fundamental difference between GEP (Good Engineering Practice) and GMP documentation requirements? Why does ISPE specifically emphasize GEP standards?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Scope（適用範圍）
blocks.en: 1.3 Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念：C&Q 的邊界劃定
blocks.en: Core Concept: Drawing the Boundary of C&Q

blocks.zh: 本節最重要的學習是：C&Q 結束的地方，PPQ 才開始。
blocks.en: The most important lesson of this section: PPQ begins where C&Q ends.

blocks.zh: C&Q 確認的是「系統符合設計規格並適合使用」，而 PPQ（製程性能確認）確認的是「這個系統可以穩定生產出符合規格的產品」。兩者的對象不同：前者是「設備/系統」，後者是「製程/產品」。
blocks.en: C&Q confirms that "the system meets design specifications and is fit for use", while PPQ (Process Performance Qualification) confirms that "this system can consistently produce product that meets specifications". The two have different subjects: the former is the equipment/system, the latter is the process/product.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：電腦系統軟體開發不在此範圍
blocks.en: Key Point: Computer System Software Development Is Out of Scope

blocks.zh: 軟體的 V&V（Validation & Verification）屬於 ISPE GAMP 5 的管轄範圍，而非本指引。這個邊界劃定非常重要——當你在確效一台 SCADA 系統時：
blocks.en: Software V&V (Validation & Verification) falls under ISPE GAMP 5, not this Guide. This boundary is very important. When you qualify a SCADA system:

blocks.zh: 硬體部分（感測器、閥門、控制盤安裝）→ ISPE Vol.5 C&Q
blocks.en: Hardware (installation of sensors, valves, control panels) → ISPE Vol. 5 C&Q

blocks.zh: 軟體部分（控制邏輯、配方管理、稽核追蹤）→ GAMP 5
blocks.en: Software (control logic, recipe management, audit trail) → GAMP 5

blocks.zh: 實務上兩者常需要整合規劃，避免重複測試或遺漏。
blocks.en: In practice, the two often need integrated planning to avoid duplicate testing or gaps.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：C&Q 是交屋驗屋，PPQ 是入住後的試住
blocks.en: Analogy: C&Q Is the Handover Inspection of a House, PPQ Is Living in It

blocks.zh: C&Q 就像你買新房子時的「交屋驗屋」——確認水電、牆壁、窗戶都按圖施工且正常運作。
blocks.en: C&Q is like the handover inspection when you buy a new house: confirming that the plumbing, electrical work, walls, and windows were built as drawn and work properly.

blocks.zh: PPQ 則是「入住後連住三個月」，確認冬天不漏風、夏天不悶熱、每天用水都足夠。
blocks.en: PPQ is like "living there for three months": confirming that it is draft-free in winter, not stuffy in summer, and that there is enough water for daily use.

blocks.zh: 兩者都必要，但性質完全不同，不能混為一談。
blocks.en: Both are necessary, but they are completely different in nature and must not be confused.

blocks.zh: 一個新藥品的製造廠正在引進用於生物製劑的單次使用生物反應器（SUB）。請列出哪些活動屬於 C&Q 範圍，哪些不屬於？
blocks.en: A new drug product manufacturing facility is introducing a single-use bioreactor (SUB) for biologics. List which activities are within the scope of C&Q and which are not.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）為何被排除在 C&Q 範圍外？這兩個活動的對象有何本質差異？
blocks.en: Why is Cleaning Validation excluded from the scope of C&Q? What is the fundamental difference in the subject of these two activities?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Process Overview and Structure of the Guide（流程概述與指引架構）
blocks.en: 1.4 Process Overview and Structure of the Guide

blocks.zh: 核心概念：整合式 C&Q 流程地圖解讀
blocks.en: Core Concept: Reading the Integrated C&Q Process Map

blocks.zh: 整個 ISPE C&Q 流程是一個由需求驅動、風險聚焦、迭代執行的架構：
blocks.en: The whole ISPE C&Q process is a requirements-driven, risk-focused, iterative structure:

blocks.zh: URS（第 2 章）→ 定義「我要什麼」
blocks.en: URS (Chapter 2) → defines "what I want"

blocks.zh: System Classification（第 3 章）→ 判斷「這個系統有多重要」
blocks.en: System Classification (Chapter 3) → determines "how important this system is"

blocks.zh: System Risk Assessment（第 4 章）→ 識別「什麼地方可能出錯」
blocks.en: System Risk Assessment (Chapter 4) → identifies "where things could go wrong"

blocks.zh: DR/DQ（第 5 章）→ 確認「設計有沒有滿足需求」
blocks.en: DR/DQ (Chapter 5) → confirms "whether the design meets the requirements"

blocks.zh: C&Q Planning（第 6 章）→ 規劃「怎麼驗」
blocks.en: C&Q Planning (Chapter 6) → plans "how to verify"

blocks.zh: Testing（第 7-8 章）→ 執行驗證並放行
blocks.en: Testing (Chapters 7-8) → executes verification and releases the system

blocks.zh: Periodic Review（第 9 章）→ 持續確保有效
blocks.en: Periodic Review (Chapter 9) → ensures continued effectiveness

blocks.zh: 重點提示：FAT 可作為 IQ 證據！
blocks.en: Key Point: FAT Can Serve as IQ Evidence!

blocks.zh: 這是 ISPE Vol.5 最具實務價值的概念之一：在供應商工廠完成的 FAT（工廠驗收測試），可以直接作為 IQ（安裝確認）的部分證據，無需到廠重複測試。
blocks.en: This is one of the most practically valuable concepts in ISPE Vol. 5: FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) completed at the supplier's facility can be used directly as part of the evidence for IQ (Installation Qualification), with no need to repeat the tests on site.

blocks.zh: 但前提是：
blocks.en: The prerequisites are:

blocks.zh: FAT 在廠商有明確 QA 監督下執行
blocks.en: The FAT is executed with clear QA oversight at the supplier

blocks.zh: FAT 協議（protocol）按 C&Q 計畫的 GEP 要求撰寫
blocks.en: The FAT protocol is written in accordance with the GEP requirements of the C&Q plan

blocks.zh: C&Q 計畫中明確記錄哪些 FAT 結果被接受作為確效證據
blocks.en: The C&Q plan clearly documents which FAT results are accepted as qualification evidence

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：直接衝擊系統就像手術室設備
blocks.en: Analogy: Direct Impact Systems Are Like Operating Room Equipment

blocks.zh: Direct Impact System（直接衝擊系統）：直接影響藥品品質的系統，如純水系統、滅菌釜、充填機。必須執行完整 Commissioning + Qualification。
blocks.en: Direct Impact System: a system that directly affects drug product quality, such as a purified water system, autoclave, or filling machine. It must undergo full Commissioning + Qualification.

blocks.zh: Not Direct Impact System（非直接衝擊系統）：如辦公室空調、廠務用水管、照明系統。只需 Commissioning，不需 Qualification 文件。
blocks.en: Not Direct Impact System: for example office air conditioning, utility mains water piping, or lighting. It needs only Commissioning, with no Qualification documentation.

blocks.zh: 就像醫院只有手術室才需要層流空調稽核，辦公室走廊的通風系統不需要同樣嚴格的驗收程序。
blocks.en: Just as in a hospital only the operating rooms need laminar-flow HVAC audits, the ventilation in an office corridor does not need the same rigorous acceptance process.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：整合 FAT/SAT 節省 30-50% 確效時間
blocks.en: Practical Application: Integrating FAT/SAT Saves 30-50% of Qualification Time

blocks.zh: CDMO 在規劃新設備導入時，如能在簽訂採購合約時就要求供應商依據 ISPE C&Q 框架撰寫 FAT 協議，並在 FAT 時派遣 QA 人員陪同，可將這些數據直接納入 IQ 報告。
blocks.en: When a CDMO plans the introduction of new equipment, if it requires the supplier at the time of the purchase contract to write the FAT protocol according to the ISPE C&Q framework, and sends QA personnel to attend the FAT, the data can be incorporated directly into the IQ report.

blocks.zh: 實際案例顯示，與傳統做法相比（FAT 後到廠再做完整 IQ），此方法可節省 30-50% 的驗證工時，並顯著縮短設備啟動時程。
blocks.en: Actual cases show that, compared with the traditional approach (a full IQ on site after FAT), this method can save 30-50% of qualification labor hours and significantly shorten equipment start-up time.

blocks.zh: 一台新採購的高效液相色層儀（HPLC），其安裝在 QC 實驗室，用於放行檢驗。它是 Direct Impact 還是 Not Direct Impact System？請說明判斷依據。
blocks.en: A newly purchased HPLC is installed in the QC laboratory and used for release testing. Is it a Direct Impact or Not Direct Impact System? Explain the basis for your decision.

blocks.zh: 廠商在工廠完成了完整的 FAT，記錄了所有感測器的校正資料。如果你是確效工程師，你需要哪些條件才能接受這份 FAT 報告作為 IQ 的一部分？
blocks.en: The supplier has completed a full FAT at its factory and recorded calibration data for all sensors. As a validation engineer, what conditions would you need in order to accept this FAT report as part of the IQ?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Rationale for this Second Edition（第二版改版說明）
blocks.en: 1.5 Rationale for this Second Edition

blocks.zh: 核心概念：V-Model 的終結與新框架的誕生
blocks.en: Core Concept: The End of the V-Model and the Birth of a New Framework

blocks.zh: V-Model（V 型模型）是 1990-2010 年代確效的黃金標準，將設計階段文件與測試階段文件對應成 V 字型：
blocks.en: The V-Model was the gold standard of validation from the 1990s to the 2010s, mapping design-phase documents to test-phase documents in a V shape:

blocks.zh: ISPE 第二版廢除 V-Model 的原因：V-Model 強調文件對應，但沒有整合「產品品質風險評估」，導致不關鍵的系統也做了大量確效測試，效率極低。
blocks.en: The reason the second edition of ISPE abandons the V-Model: the V-Model emphasizes document correspondence but does not integrate "product quality risk assessment", so non-critical systems also underwent extensive qualification testing, which was highly inefficient.

blocks.zh: 新框架以 QRM（品質風險管理）為核心，只對真正影響產品品質的 CDE 進行確效。
blocks.en: The new framework has QRM (Quality Risk Management) at its core and qualifies only the CDEs that truly affect product quality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「Indirect Impact」術語被廢除
blocks.en: Key Point: The Term "Indirect Impact" Is Abolished

blocks.zh: 第一版有三分類：Direct Impact / Indirect Impact / No Impact。第二版簡化為兩分類：Direct Impact / Not Direct Impact。
blocks.en: The first edition had three classifications: Direct Impact / Indirect Impact / No Impact. The second edition simplifies this to two: Direct Impact / Not Direct Impact.

blocks.zh: 原因：「Indirect Impact」在實務上定義模糊，常造成確效工程師爭議——清潔用水算 Indirect 還是 Direct？廠房 HVAC 呢？
blocks.en: Reason: "Indirect Impact" was vaguely defined in practice and often caused disputes among validation engineers: is cleaning water Indirect or Direct? What about facility HVAC?

blocks.zh: 新分類更清晰：「有沒有直接影響產品品質？」只有兩個答案。
blocks.en: The new classification is clearer: "Does it directly affect product quality?" There are only two answers.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：從「全身健康檢查」到「針對性精密檢查」
blocks.en: Analogy: From a "Full-Body Checkup" to a "Targeted Precision Examination"

blocks.zh: 傳統 V-Model 確效就像每年做全身健康檢查：腦部、心臟、腸胃、骨質……每個器官都掃一遍，不管你有沒有症狀。費時費錢。
blocks.en: Traditional V-Model qualification is like a full-body checkup every year: brain, heart, digestive tract, bone density... every organ is scanned whether or not you have symptoms. It is time-consuming and expensive.

blocks.zh: ISPE 新框架就像根據你的個人健康風險做針對性精密檢查：有心臟病家族史→重點檢查心臟；有糖尿病風險→重點監控血糖。其他沒有風險的部位，例行檢查就夠了。
blocks.en: The new ISPE framework is like a targeted precision examination based on your personal health risks: a family history of heart disease means a focused cardiac check; a risk of diabetes means close blood glucose monitoring. For areas with no risk, a routine checkup is enough.

blocks.zh: 這就是「Science and Risk-Based C&Q」的本質——聚焦真正的風險。
blocks.en: This is the essence of "Science and Risk-Based C&Q": focusing on real risk.

blocks.zh: 你的公司目前用傳統 V-Model 進行確效，有一批老舊的 Legacy 系統（按第一版 ISPE 完成確效）。你的稽查員問：「這些系統需要按第二版重新確效嗎？」本節給了什麼指引？
blocks.en: Your company currently uses the traditional V-Model for qualification and has a number of old legacy systems (qualified under the first edition of ISPE). Your auditor asks: "Do these systems need to be requalified under the second edition?" What guidance does this section provide?

blocks.zh: 為什麼廢除「Component Criticality Assessment（元件關鍵性評估）」能提升效率？請解釋 System Risk Assessment 如何取代它的功能。
blocks.en: Why does abolishing "Component Criticality Assessment" improve efficiency? Explain how System Risk Assessment replaces its function.

blocks.zh: 1.6 Key Concepts（關鍵概念）
blocks.en: 1.6 Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 1.6.1 核心概念：Commissioning 文件 = 可提交稽查的品質文件
blocks.en: 1.6.1 Core Concept: Commissioning Documents = Quality Documents That Can Be Submitted to Inspectors

blocks.zh: 這是最容易被誤解的地方。許多工程師認為試車文件是「工程文件」，只要技術上正確就夠，不需要按 GMP 標準撰寫。
blocks.en: This is the most commonly misunderstood point. Many engineers believe commissioning documents are "engineering documents" that only need to be technically correct and need not be written to GMP standards.

blocks.zh: ISPE 的立場非常明確：當試車測試用來支持確效時，這些文件必須能接受法規稽查。意思是：
blocks.en: ISPE's position is very clear: when commissioning tests are used to support qualification, these documents must withstand regulatory inspection. This means:

blocks.zh: 數據必須真實、及時記錄（no backdating）
blocks.en: Data must be recorded truthfully and contemporaneously (no backdating)

blocks.zh: 偏差（Discrepancy）必須有記錄和處理
blocks.en: Discrepancies must be documented and handled

blocks.zh: 簽核程序必須完整
blocks.en: The sign-off process must be complete

blocks.zh: 工程師完成的試車報告品質直接決定確效效率——好的 FAT 報告可省掉大量重複測試。
blocks.en: The quality of the commissioning reports completed by engineers directly determines qualification efficiency: a good FAT report can eliminate a great deal of repeat testing.

blocks.zh: 1.6.2 重點提示：WFI 系統的 CPP 如何定義？
blocks.en: 1.6.2 Key Point: How Are the CPPs of a WFI System Defined?

blocks.zh: WFI 系統本身不直接生產藥品，但其輸出水質影響所有使用 WFI 的製程。因此：
blocks.en: A WFI system does not itself manufacture drug product, but the quality of its output water affects every process that uses WFI. Therefore:

blocks.zh: WFI 的 CQA = WFI 的內毒素限值、導電度、TOC（這些是「中間品質屬性」）
blocks.en: The CQAs of WFI = the endotoxin limit, conductivity, and TOC of WFI (these are "intermediate quality attributes")

blocks.zh: WFI 的 CPP = 蒸餾溫度、循環流速、循環壓力
blocks.en: The CPPs of WFI = distillation temperature, circulation flow rate, circulation pressure

blocks.zh: WFI 的 CDE = 溫度感測器精度、熱交換器完整性、迴路材質（316L 不鏽鋼）
blocks.en: The CDEs of WFI = temperature sensor accuracy, heat exchanger integrity, loop material (316L stainless steel)

blocks.zh: 理解這個延伸應用，有助於確效工程師在面對 utility 系統時不會束手無策。
blocks.en: Understanding this extended application helps validation engineers avoid being at a loss when facing utility systems.

blocks.zh: 1.6.3 核心概念：QA 是品質保證角色，不是文件審查機器
blocks.en: 1.6.3 Core Concept: QA Is a Quality Assurance Role, Not a Document Review Machine

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調：Quality Unit 的角色是 Quality Assurance（品質保證），不是 Documentation Quality Control（文件品管）。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically stresses that the role of the Quality Unit is Quality Assurance, not Documentation Quality Control.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：
blocks.en: Practical implications:

blocks.zh: QA 不需要逐字審查所有技術細節（那是 SME 的責任）
blocks.en: QA does not need to review every technical detail word by word (that is the SME's responsibility)

blocks.zh: QA 需要確認 C&Q 計畫是否涵蓋了所有產品品質風險
blocks.en: QA needs to confirm that the C&Q plan covers all product quality risks

blocks.zh: QA 負責最終的放行決定，基於風險評估結果，不是基於文件厚度
blocks.en: QA is responsible for the final release decision, based on the results of the risk assessment, not on the thickness of the documentation

blocks.zh: 這個觀念轉變對很多台灣 CDMO 的 QA 部門是重要的文化挑戰。
blocks.en: This shift in mindset is an important cultural challenge for the QA departments of many Taiwanese CDMOs.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：QA 是法官，SME 是鑑定人
blocks.en: Analogy: QA Is the Judge, the SME Is the Expert Witness

blocks.zh: 法庭上，法官（QA）不需要自己做 DNA 鑑定，但必須評估鑑定人（SME）提交的報告是否可信、是否足夠支持裁決。
blocks.en: In court, the judge (QA) does not need to run DNA analysis personally, but must assess whether the report submitted by the expert witness (SME) is credible and sufficient to support a ruling.

blocks.zh: 最終放行決定由法官（QA）做出，責任歸屬明確。鑑定人（SME）提供技術判斷，不應該被要求超出自己專業範圍之外。
blocks.en: The final release decision is made by the judge (QA), with clear accountability. The expert witness (SME) provides technical judgment and should not be asked to go beyond their own area of expertise.

blocks.zh: 一個新的 CIP（就地清洗）系統正在完成 FAT，供應商提交了測試報告，但其中有 3 項偏差未按 ISPE GEP 標準記錄（只有口頭說明，無書面記錄）。作為確效工程師，你應如何處理？
blocks.en: A new CIP (clean-in-place) system is completing FAT. The supplier submitted a test report, but 3 of the deviations were not documented according to ISPE GEP standards (only verbal explanations, no written record). As a validation engineer, how should you handle this?

blocks.zh: 你的 QA Director 說：「每一份確效報告我都要逐行審查才放心。」根據 ISPE 1.6.3 的精神，這種做法有何風險？應如何調整？
blocks.en: Your QA Director says: "I need to review every qualification report line by line to feel comfortable." Based on the spirit of ISPE 1.6.3, what are the risks of this practice? How should it be adjusted?

blocks.zh: 1.7 Key Terms（關鍵術語定義）
blocks.en: 1.7 Key Terms

blocks.zh: 術語辨析：IQ / OQ / PQ 與 C&Q 的關係
blocks.en: Term Clarification: The Relationship Between IQ / OQ / PQ and C&Q

blocks.zh: ISPE 第二版保留了 IQ/OQ/PQ 的定義，但在實際執行上，它們是 C&Q 過程的輸出文件，而非獨立步驟。
blocks.en: The second edition of ISPE retains the definitions of IQ/OQ/PQ, but in actual execution they are output documents of the C&Q process, not independent steps.

blocks.zh:
傳統思維：先做 IQ → 再做 OQ → 再做 PQ（三段式串列）
ISPE 新思維：FAT、SAT、現場測試按邏輯規劃，IQ/OQ/PQ 文件是這些測試的結果整理，不是強制的執行順序。
blocks.en:
Traditional thinking: do IQ first → then OQ → then PQ (three sequential stages)
ISPE new thinking: FAT, SAT, and on-site tests are planned logically, and the IQ/OQ/PQ documents are a summary of the results of these tests, not a mandatory execution sequence.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Deviation vs. Discrepancy 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Point: The Critical Difference Between Deviation and Discrepancy

blocks.zh: Discrepancy（偏差事項）：任何不符合預期的結果，可以是輕微的，可能可以直接修正。
blocks.en: Discrepancy: any result that does not meet expectations. It may be minor and may be corrected directly.

blocks.zh: Deviation（確效偏差）：ISPE 特別定義為「影響 CA/CDE 的嚴重差異，且無法直接修正」——必須獲得 Quality Unit 批准才能關閉。
blocks.en: Deviation: specifically defined by ISPE as "a significant difference affecting a CA/CDE that cannot be directly corrected". It must be approved by the Quality Unit before it can be closed.

blocks.zh: 在確效報告中混用這兩個術語是常見錯誤，容易在稽查時引發不必要的問題。
blocks.en: Mixing up these two terms in qualification reports is a common mistake and easily causes unnecessary problems during inspections.

blocks.zh: 術語速查表（繁體中文對照）
blocks.en: Key Terms Quick Reference

blocks.zh:
C&Q       = 試車與確效（Commissioning and Qualification）
CDE       = 關鍵設計要素（Critical Design Element）
CA        = 關鍵特性（Critical Aspect）
CPP       = 關鍵製程參數（Critical Process Parameter）
CQA       = 關鍵品質屬性（Critical Quality Attribute）
DQ        = 設計確認（Design Qualification）
DR        = 設計審查（Design Review）
FAT       = 工廠驗收測試（Factory Acceptance Testing）
SAT       = 現場驗收測試（Site Acceptance Testing）
IQ        = 安裝確認（Installation Qualification）
OQ        = 操作確認（Operational Qualification）
PQ        = 性能確認（Performance Qualification）
QRM       = 品質風險管理（Quality Risk Management）
SME       = 主題專家（Subject Matter Expert）
URS       = 使用者需求規格（User Requirements Specification）
GEP       = 良好工程規範（Good Engineering Practice）
blocks.en:
C&Q       = Commissioning and Qualification
CDE       = Critical Design Element
CA        = Critical Aspect
CPP       = Critical Process Parameter
CQA       = Critical Quality Attribute
DQ        = Design Qualification
DR        = Design Review
FAT       = Factory Acceptance Testing
SAT       = Site Acceptance Testing
IQ        = Installation Qualification
OQ        = Operational Qualification
PQ        = Performance Qualification
QRM       = Quality Risk Management
SME       = Subject Matter Expert
URS       = User Requirements Specification
GEP       = Good Engineering Practice

blocks.zh: 實務應用：如何在稽查中使用這些定義
blocks.en: Practical Application: How to Use These Definitions During Inspections

blocks.zh: 當 FDA 查員詢問：「你們如何定義 Direct Impact System？」，最佳回答方式：
blocks.en: When an FDA investigator asks, "How do you define a Direct Impact System?", the best way to answer is to:

blocks.zh: 引用 ISPE Vol.5 2nd Ed. 的定義（直接影響產品 CQA 的系統）
blocks.en: Cite the definition in ISPE Vol. 5 2nd Ed. (a system that directly affects product CQAs)

blocks.zh: 展示你們的 System Classification 工具表（第 3 章）
blocks.en: Show your System Classification tool sheet (Chapter 3)

blocks.zh: 說明哪些系統被分類為 Direct Impact，以及判斷依據
blocks.en: Explain which systems are classified as Direct Impact and the basis for each decision

blocks.zh: 事先建立一份系統分類清冊，在每次稽查前更新，可大幅提升稽查效率。
blocks.en: Establishing a system classification inventory in advance and updating it before each inspection can greatly improve inspection efficiency.

blocks.zh: 請將以下系統分類為 Direct Impact 或 Not Direct Impact，並說明理由：(a) 注射用水系統 (b) 廠房壓差監控系統 (c) 無菌室 HVAC (d) 辦公室中央空調 (e) 自動化充填機 PLC
blocks.en: Classify the following systems as Direct Impact or Not Direct Impact and explain your reasoning: (a) water for injection system (b) facility differential pressure monitoring system (c) aseptic area HVAC (d) office central air conditioning (e) automated filling machine PLC

blocks.zh: 一台滅菌釜在 PQ 測試中，某個循環的最冷點溫度為 120.8°C（規格 ≥121°C），屬於 Discrepancy 還是 Deviation？這份文件應如何處理？
blocks.en: During PQ testing of an autoclave, the cold spot temperature in one cycle was 120.8°C (specification ≥121°C). Is this a Discrepancy or a Deviation? How should this document be handled?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: C&Q 的核心定義：Commissioning（工程試車）+ Qualification（品質確效）整合為一個科學與風險驅動的流程，核心差異在於 Quality Unit 的參與
blocks.en: Core definition of C&Q: Commissioning (engineering) + Qualification (quality) are integrated into one science- and risk-driven process; the key difference is Quality Unit involvement

blocks.zh: CDE 是確效的聚焦點：透過 QRM → CQA → CPP → CA → CDE 的層級識別，確保只對真正重要的系統特性進行確效測試
blocks.en: CDEs are the focus of qualification: identification through the QRM → CQA → CPP → CA → CDE hierarchy ensures that only the truly important system characteristics undergo qualification testing

blocks.zh: 第二版主要改版：廢除 V-Model、廢除「Indirect Impact」分類、廢除 Component Criticality Assessment，以 QRM 整合為核心
blocks.en: Main changes in the second edition: abolishes the V-Model, the "Indirect Impact" classification, and Component Criticality Assessment, with QRM integration as the core

blocks.zh: FAT 可作為確效證據：供應商工廠完成的測試在 GEP 標準下可直接作為 IQ 文件，避免重複測試，縮短確效週期
blocks.en: FAT can serve as qualification evidence: tests completed at the supplier's facility under GEP standards can be used directly as IQ documentation, avoiding repeat testing and shortening the qualification cycle

blocks.zh: QA 的角色定位：QA 是品質保證的最終決策者，不是文件逐字審查員；SME 負責技術判斷，QA 負責風險評估與放行批准
blocks.en: The role of QA: QA is the final decision-maker for quality assurance, not a word-by-word document reviewer; SMEs are responsible for technical judgment, QA for risk assessment and release approval

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語必記：CDE、CA、Deviation vs. Discrepancy、Direct Impact System 的精確定義是法規稽查時的必備知識
blocks.en: Key terms to remember: the precise definitions of CDE, CA, Deviation vs. Discrepancy, and Direct Impact System are essential knowledge during regulatory inspections
